characters.name: Blue
characters.about: Vox's main character: an American pit bull terrier with a blue nose, a blue-grey coat, white blaze, chest and paws, rose ears and an orange collar.

characters.name: Agent (buzz cut)
characters.about: Secret Service agent: black suit, white shirt, black tie, red lapel pin, sunglasses, earpiece with coil, buzz cut.

characters.name: Agent (bun)
characters.about: Secret Service agent: same suit, sunglasses and earpiece, hair in a tight bun.

characters.name: Agent (shaved head)
characters.about: Secret Service agent: same suit, sunglasses and earpiece, shaved head.

characters.name: Business executive
characters.about: Tech-style executive: black MAGA cap, black T-shirt under a black suit jacket, jeans, black sneakers, silver glasses, short goatee, watch. Not based on anyone.

characters.name: Judge
characters.about: Black robe with pleats and wide sleeves, white collar, maroon tie, glasses, grey hair thinning on top.

characters.name: Lead
characters.about: The original lead, no longer the main character: red cap, blue overalls over a white undershirt, short brown beard.

characters.name: Officer
characters.about: Capitol-style police officer: peaked cap, duty belt with radio, gold badge, POLICE on the back.

characters.name: Plain-clothes officer
characters.about: Undercover detective: brown leather jacket over a grey T-shirt, jeans, badge on the belt, short dark hair and mustache.

characters.name: President
characters.about: Fictional president: royal-blue suit, gold tie, flag pin, short blonde hair, clean-shaven. Not based on any real president.

characters.name: Rally-goer (bucket hat)
characters.about: Stars-and-stripes shirt, khaki shorts with tube socks, white beard, sunglasses, bucket hat.

characters.name: Rally-goer (sign)
characters.about: Flag-print T-shirt, jeans, white sneakers, navy USA cap with a blonde ponytail through the back; waves a sign.

characters.name: Reporter
characters.about: TV reporter: teal blazer, press badge on a lanyard, black bob with bangs, carries a microphone.

characters.name: Representative
characters.about: House member: burgundy blazer, gold member pin and earrings, full curly hair. Not based on anyone.

characters.name: Representative (beard)
characters.about: Grey suit, purple tie, short black hair and full trimmed beard. Not based on anyone.

characters.name: Representative (cream blazer)
characters.about: Cream skirt suit over a navy top, long straight black hair. Not based on anyone.

characters.name: Representative (open collar)
characters.about: Navy blazer, open-collar blue shirt, no tie, brown quiff. Not based on anyone.

characters.name: Representative (ponytail)
characters.about: Green blazer, white blouse, copper-red ponytail. Not based on anyone.

characters.name: Riot officer A
characters.about: Riot officer: black helmet with clear visor and neck guard, chest and back plates, shoulder pads, knee and shin guards, gloves, POLICE on the back.

characters.name: Riot officer B
characters.about: Riot officer, second face under the same gear.

characters.name: Senator
characters.about: Generic legislator: charcoal suit, blue tie, flag pin, silver side-parted hair. Not based on anyone.

characters.name: Senator (glasses)
characters.about: Charcoal suit, green tie, wire glasses, thinning white hair. Not based on anyone.

characters.name: Senator (plum suit)
characters.about: Plum pantsuit, gold pin, short natural hair with grey flecks. Not based on anyone.

characters.name: Senator (silver bob)
characters.about: Slate skirt suit, silver brooch, silver chin-length bob. Not based on anyone.

characters.name: Senator (tan suit)
characters.about: Tan suit, brown tie, close-cropped black hair greying at the temples. Not based on anyone.

characters.name: Staffer
characters.about: Overworked Hill staffer: rolled sleeves, loose off-centre tie, red lanyard and ID badge, chinos, cowlick.

characters.name: The Brain
characters.about: The Brain, from the comic From the Brain of Michael Collins: Michael's brain in a jar, pink with round glasses, floating in sloshing fluid, on a professor in a red plaid flannel shirt. Computer scientist, dungeon master, lore expert; fact-checks everything.

characters.name: Vice President
characters.about: Fictional vice president: black suit, white collar, gold lapel pin, silver side-swept short hair. Not based on any real vice president.

characters.name: Yuzu
characters.about: Yuzu, a calm capybara: warm brown barrel body, big blunt muzzle, small round ears. Chills, soaks in the hot spring with a towel on its head, balances a yuzu, snacks on watermelon and nods off.

characters.name: Cat
characters.about: Grey tabby cat: striped back and crown, white chest and socks, pink nose, whiskers, tall tail.

characters.name: Dog
characters.about: Golden-furred dog: cream muzzle and paws, floppy brown ears, red bandana with a gold tag.

characters.name: Donkey
characters.about: Donkey in a blue blazer over an open-collar white shirt and jeans; tall ears, dark mane, pale muzzle.

characters.name: Peanut
characters.about: Original peanut character: two-lobed dimpled shell, stick limbs, cream hands, orange ball cap, sneakers.

characters.name: Army peanut
characters.about: Roasted peanut as an army man: olive helmet with chin strap, webbing, belt pouches, radio pack, rifle slung on the back, combat boots.

characters.name: Fry cook peanut
characters.about: Roasted peanut as a fry cook: red uniform, white apron with a name tag, paper fold hat, black work shoes.

characters.name: Garbage collector peanut
characters.about: Roasted peanut as a garbage collector: lime hi-vis vest with silver reflective bands over navy work clothes, orange cap, yellow work gloves, brown boots.

characters.name: Medic peanut
characters.about: Roasted peanut as a medic: teal scrubs, white vest with a green first-aid cross front and back, stethoscope, headband, blue gloves.

characters.name: Miami Travis
characters.about: Roasted peanut as a 1980s Miami detective: pastel teal jacket with pushed-up sleeves over a pink tee, white pants, loafers without socks, aviator shades.

characters.name: Riot peanut
characters.about: Roasted peanut as a riot officer: black helmet with a clear visor and neck guard, chest and back plates, shoulder and knee pads; clear shield, baton, radio.

characters.name: Rhino
characters.about: Rhino in a navy suit, white shirt, red tie and flag pin; big ivory horn, wrinkled grey hide.
